info.title: Transformômetro API — Custom GPT Actions
info.description: Compact facade for OpenAI Custom GPT. Analyzes KPIs and creates/edits Transformômetro records with the same Keycloak JWT + Core RBAC as the UI. Do not expose binary uploads, collaboration locks, or public signature signing here.

tags.name: Transformômetro GPT
tags.description: Custom GPT Actions for analyze / register / edit.

get.summary: Search or list records by entity
get.description: List records. Use `parent_id` for children (instances/revisions of a process, investments of a revision). For revisions prefer `instance_id` to isolate one melhoria. Use `q` for process text search.

Process knowledge (Markdown): process_document. Documents: decomposition_tree, process_diagram, impact_effort_matrix and related overlays.

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token from OAuth Authorization Code (client chatgpt-transformometro). Audience must include delpi-central.

ApiEnvelope.description: Canonical API envelope. On errors ALWAYS read message and data.errors — never report only the HTTP status code to the user.

message.description: Human-readable outcome or validation summary (e.g. missing required fields).

data.description: Payload on success, or structured error details (often {errors:[{field,reason}], error_count}).

GptMyContextResponse.description: Minimal personal context. Not authorization metadata.

display_name.description: Canonical display name from Core identity.

profile_complete.description: True when display_name and email are both present.

GptRecordBody.description: Wrapper required by GPT Actions. Never put CRUD fields at the root; always nest them under data. See gpt_get_catalog.registration_guide entity_schemas for required/optional per entity.

data.description: CRUD payload keyed by entity. Explicit properties cover process, instance, revision, measurement, investment, shared_resource, resource_cost, resource_link, catalogs, documents and matrix writes.

codigo_processo.description: Business process code. Optional on create (auto-generated if omitted). Mutable on update; omit/null keeps current (never clears). Distinct from immutable processo_id.

descricao_processo.description: On process update: omit keeps current; null clears.

gestor_responsavel.description: On process update: omit keeps current; null clears.

objetivo_processo.description: On process update: omit keeps current; null clears.

recurso_compartilhado_id.description: Required when entity=resource_cost (create) or entity=resource_link. Alias: recurso_id.

recurso_id.description: Alias of recurso_compartilhado_id for resource_cost create.

filial_id.description: Required for entity=instance unless todas_filiais_ativas=true (omit filial_id then).

todas_filiais_ativas.description: When true, instance applies to all active units; do not send filial_id.

data_inicio_vigencia.description: Revision or resource_cost start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required on resource_cost create; optional on update (merges).

data_fim_vigencia.description: Omit = open/unset on create; null = clear on update; date = set. Never invent today.

confirm_vigencia_change.description: Required true when changing revision vigência and measurement exists.

recorrencia.description: Investment or shared_resource recurrence (e.g. unico, mensal).

valor_total_recorrente.description: Legacy catalog total; prefer entity=resource_cost for vigências.

valor_mensal.description: Monthly cost for entity=resource_cost. Required on create; on update may be sent alone (other fields merge from current row).

vigente_desde.description: Used by UI reajuste flows; prefer data_inicio_vigencia in GPT writes.

unit_code.description: Filial code for entity=meeting_minute (01|02; zero-padded to 2 digits).

title.description: Title for entity=meeting_minute or entity=process_document (required on create).

content_md.description: Markdown body for entity=process_document. Optional on create (defaults to empty); omit on update to keep current.

meeting_type.description: Meeting type for entity=meeting_minute (default ordinary). Must match catalog enum.

meeting_date.description: Required on meeting_minute create. Format YYYY-MM-DD only (not DD/MM/AAAA).

responsible_user_id.description: Optional UUID. Omit or null to leave empty — never send "".

items.description: Meeting-minute participant row. Entity-specific bag; signature capture remains UI-only.
Meeting-minute signer row. Signature capture remains UI-only.

signers.description: Signers for entity=meeting_minute (signature capture remains UI-only).

conteudo.description: Document payload (diagram flowchart or decomposition tree/overlay).

node_ids.description: Scope node ids for instance diagram/decomposition scope.

inputs_manuais.description: Impact×effort matrix manual inputs. Cell keys vary by matrix mode.

overrides.description: Impact×effort matrix overrides. Cell keys vary by matrix mode.

GptEvidenceManageBody.description: Link/metadata evidence only. Binary upload/download is BLOCKED_BY_PLATFORM for Custom GPT Actions.

GptAdjustSharedResourceCostBody.description: Canonical shared-resource cost adjustment (registrar_reajuste). Not a generic resource_cost CRUD.

GptMeetingMinuteManageBody.description: Meeting-minute extras beyond send/finalize/cancel (use gpt_meeting_minute_workflow for those).

data.description: Action-specific payload. For resend: {confirm_resend:true}. For set_participants/set_signers: participants[]/signers[]. For generate_from_transcript: unit_code + transcript_html.

GptImprovementPackageBody.description: Nested improvement package only. Never put revision fields flat under scenario (e.g. scenario.versao_revisao). Always use scenario.revision.{fields} and baseline.revision.{fields}. Never put processo_id/instancia_id on scenario root; use process and instance. measurement belongs under baseline.measurement or scenario.measurement.

dry_run.description: When true: HTTP 200, no writes; ready=false + missing[] if incomplete. ready=false is checklist guidance, not tool failure.

activate_scenario.description: Activate the scenario revision after successful commit only (never during dry_run).

recalculate.description: Recalculate dashboard cache after successful commit.

process.description: REQUIRED. Reuse with id or processo_id, OR create with nome_processo + status_processo (+ optional process fields).

instance.description: REQUIRED. Reuse with id or instancia_id, OR create with setor_ids and filial_id|todas_filiais_ativas.

baseline.description: Optional baseline block. Nested revision + measurement (volume_mensal + tempo_medio_execucao_min required when creating). cenario_tipo is forced to baseline by the service.

scenario.description: Optional scenario block. MUST nest revision under scenario.revision (never flat versao_revisao/processo_id on scenario root). New scenario.revision REQUIRES scenario.measurement (volume_mensal + tempo_medio_execucao_min). revisao_referencia_id required unless baseline is in the same package. investments may be [].

investments.description: Investment lines; empty array is valid.

GptPackageRevision.description: Revision fields for baseline.revision or scenario.revision. beneficio_calculo_categoria belongs here, not on measurement.

cenario_tipo.description: Required on create for scenario; forced to baseline in baseline block.

revisao_referencia_id.description: Required for non-baseline create unless baseline is created in the same package.

data_fim_vigencia.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date, or null for open vigencia. Omitted on create = leave NULL (do not invent today). Omitted on update (GPT) = keep current; explicit null = clear.

GptPackageMeasurement.description: Required when creating a new revision in the package. Must include volume_mensal and tempo_medio_execucao_min.

GptValidateImprovementPackageBody.description: Nested package only: process, instance, baseline?, scenario?. No dry_run/activate_scenario/recalculate. Never persists.
